# Industrial Error Code Fixes — llms.txt
# https://errorcodefixes.com

> errorcodefixes.com provides step-by-step troubleshooting guides for industrial equipment error codes.
> Content covers HVAC systems, CNC machines, commercial refrigeration, VFDs, boilers, ice machines,
> welding equipment, and commercial kitchen equipment. All guides are verified by certified industrial
> and HVAC technicians. Each article includes: error code meaning, common causes, step-by-step fix
> instructions, and parts that may need replacement with pricing.

## Site Structure

- Homepage: https://errorcodefixes.com — search interface and recent guides
- All guides: https://errorcodefixes.com/posts — complete list of 900+ error code articles
- By equipment: https://errorcodefixes.com/tags — browse by brand or equipment type
- Sitemap: https://errorcodefixes.com/sitemap-index.xml

## Coverage

### HVAC & Heating
Brands: Carrier, Goodman, Lennox, Trane, Rheem, York, Daikin, Mitsubishi, Fujitsu, Bosch, Bryant, Coleman
Content: Furnace error codes, heat pump faults, mini-split error codes, boiler lockout codes

### Commercial Refrigeration & Ice Machines
Brands: Hoshizaki, Manitowoc, Scotsman, True, Beverage-Air, Hussmann, Heatcraft, Turbo Air
Content: Walk-in cooler alarms, reach-in refrigerator error codes, ice machine fault codes

### CNC Machines
Brands: Fanuc, Haas, Mazak, Okuma, Siemens Sinumerik, Heidenhain, DMG Mori, Doosan
Content: Servo alarms, spindle faults, axis errors, ATC faults

### Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)
Brands: ABB, Yaskawa, Allen-Bradley, Danfoss, Siemens, Schneider, Mitsubishi, Fuji
Content: Overcurrent faults, overvoltage, undervoltage, overtemperature, ground faults

### Commercial Kitchen & Food Service
Brands: Hobart, Rational, Henny Penny, Manitowoc, Garland, Vulcan, TurboChef
Content: Commercial oven faults, dishwasher error codes, fryer error codes

## Article Format

Each article at https://errorcodefixes.com/posts/[slug]/ includes:
1. Error code meaning (1-sentence summary)
2. Common causes (bulleted list)
3. Step-by-step fix (numbered diagnostic and repair steps)
4. Parts that may need replacement (table with part numbers, costs, and purchase links)
5. When to call a professional
6. Pro tip (technician insight)
